inv.desc_en:
Discover this fantastic opportunity in the new area of Benicalap! We offer you a spacious commercial space that could be the perfect place for your business.

With a total construction area of 150 m2 and 120 m2 of usable space, you will have enough room to unleash your ideas.

In addition, it has a smoke vent, ideal for restaurants or cafes.

The contract can be made with flexible terms: you can choose to start with 10 or even up to 15 years!

This space is located in a strategic position between Av. Juan XXIII and Camino de Moncada, surrounded by various businesses and benefiting from the growing potential thanks to new buildings; it's like starting from scratch!

Remember that you will need to set up basic services such as electricity and water before starting. Don't miss this unique opportunity to grow your project here; come visit it today!
inv.title_en: Commercial premises for rent in Nou Benicalap
